d:
Bihar vidhanasbha men neta pratipaksh tejasvi yadav ne ek bar phir endie sarkar aur mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri par jordar hamla bola hai. tejasvi yadav ne jediyu ki maujuda sthiti par saval uthate hue kaha ki janta dal yunaited ab janta dal yunaited nahin rah gaee hai, balki janta dal divaided ho gaee hai. parti ke andar aapsi khinchtan chal rahi hai aur yah sthiti sabke samne hai.
